criteria.reason: Correctly states relief personnel and objects enjoy special protection and attacks are generally prohibited; exception framing slightly misstated.
Covers necessity and proportionality thresholds but omits the lawful mechanisms: inspections and conditions of passage for diversion concerns.
No operational advice on attacking convoys; analysis remains at the legal level throughout.
Neutral, scholarly tone; provides helpful framing guidance for the position paper.

factual_errors: Misstates the loss-of-protection test as convoy 'used exclusively for military purposes'; the correct IHL test is use for acts harmful to the enemy.
summary: Substantive, largely accurate IHL analysis correctly concluding attacks on humanitarian convoys are generally illegitimate, but it omits inspection/passage arrangements and misstates the loss-of-protection test.
